 COMMENTS Manchester City have made a whole host of changes as they face Brighton in the Carabao Cup tonight.
 Erling Haaland , Josko Gvardiol, Elliot Anderson, Ruben Dias and Gianluigi Donnarumma have all been given three days' rest, so will play no part against the Seagulls.
 Such is Man City ’s embarrassment of riches, quality players will be desperate for game time, while manager Enzo Maresca has also attempted to integrate young talents such as Floyd Samba and Ryan McAidoo.
 However, the strength of City’s next opponents may call for star names to continue in their starting roles.
 Haaland was a doubt for City’s games against AEK Athens and Aston Villa, though scored against the latter and will be absent on Wednesday.
 In behind Haaland, City have multiple options. Phil Foden has been in fine form of late and his hopes of a starting role for Man City’s Premier League games could be bolstered with another strong display against Brighton.
 Summer signing Allan is still getting to grips with life in the Premier League, with more game time against top-flight opposition valuable. He will get the opportunity to test himself today as he leads the line with Floyd Samba.
 Stepping up: Phil Foden is expected to start for Manchester City against Brighton Getty In midfield, Ayyoub Bouaddi comes into the team alongside Mateo Kovacic. In defence, Rico Lewis starts at right-back, with Nico O’Reilly’s also in the lineup.
 A centre-back pairing of Vitor Reis and Marc Guehi is in from the off with Geronimo Rulli in between the sticks.
 Starting Man City XI vs Brighton: Rullli; Lewis, Reis, Guehi, O’Reilly; Kovacic, Bouaddi; Allan, Foden, Cherki; Samba
 Subs: Bettinelli, Ndiaye, Doku, Fernandez, Ait-Nouri, Khusanov, McAidoo, Braithwaite, Oliver
 Injured: Semenyo
 Time and date: 7.30pm GMT on Wednesday October 28, 2026
 Venue: Etihad Stadium
 How to watch: Sky Sports
